properties.displayName: CCC.ObjStor.CN02 - Storage accounts must not allow public blob access
properties.description: Denies storage accounts that permit anonymous public blob access. Maps to FINOS CCC ObjStor CN02 (Prevent Anonymous or Public Access to Buckets and Objects) and enforces the AVM storage-account sample setting 'allow_nested_items_to_be_public = false'.

metadata.ccc_title: Prevent Anonymous or Public Access to Buckets and Objects

metadata.description: Enable or disable the execution of the policy.
